title: Epic Games Achievement Progress Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Video-game sessions (`game:session`), achievement unlocks (`achievement:unlock`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), chess games (`chess:game`), dice rolls (`dice:roll`).
app: Gaming and tabletop telemetry — Steam / PSN / Xbox playtime and achievement APIs, BoardGameGeek plays export, Lichess / Chess.com game archives, and tabletop dice-roller logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=epic:achievement progress_pct=*
| stats sum(progress_pct) as total_value, avg(progress_pct) as avg_value by game_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks game values by total and average progress percent across Epic Games achievement events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `progress_pct` values for each Epic Games achievement event and review total and average progress percent by game.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total progress percent.
grandmaExplanation: It scans which game shows the biggest progress percent numbers in your Epic Games achievement data.
